description: This file implements a Widevine platform class, 'WidevinePlatformDRM', responsible for handling decryption operations via handle conversion and interaction with the Widevine CDM. It includes constructors, destructors, and decryption methods, and references external components like 'avbConvertHandleToSecurePointer' and '_cdm->decrypt'.

classes.name: WidevinePlatformDRM
classes.description: A class encapsulating Widevine DRM platform decryption functionalities, including constructor/destructor and decrypt methods handling handle conversion and session-based decryption.

methods.name: WidevinePlatformDRM(widevine::Cdm * cdm)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Widevine platform DRM object.

methods.name: ~WidevinePlatformDRM()
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up the Widevine platform DRM object.

methods.name: widevine::Cdm::Status decryptWithHandle(int32_t handle,const std::string & session_id,const widevine::Cdm::DecryptionBatch & batch)
methods.description: Decrypts data associated with a handle and a decryption batch, converting the handle to a secure pointer, setting data parameters, and invoking the CDM's decrypt method.

methods.name: decryptWithHandle (overload)
methods.description: Decrypts data associated with a handle, session ID, and decryption batch, performing handle conversion, setting output data, and calling CDM's decrypt with session context.
